subject: Marketly renewal: variance buffer & graceband proposal
messages:
From: Ari Gold <ari@marketly.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@marketly.ai>
Date: 2026-10-15T10:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal window + commit uplift question

Sean / Vanessa —

Hope you’re both well. Marketly’s traffic from our recommendation service spiked in Q3 and we’re running into the soft throttle more frequently than expected. Procurement asked me to get ahead of the renewal, since our contract is up in December.

High level: we want to increase our hosted commit by ~2.5x for the next 12 months, add a small buffer for seasonal variance, and see if Redwood can offer a short bridge while we finalize volume commitments. We value consistency in latency and predictable unit cost — that’s why we’ve stuck with Redwood.

Can you share a proposal that shows monthly commit tiers, an interim graceband for variance (we call it a buffer pocket for unexpected burst), and any rate concessions if we sign a 12-mo term today?

I’ve attached a simple Q3 usage extract for context.

Thanks,
Ari
Head of Product
Marketly AI
[Attachment: q3-usage-breakdown.csv (CSV, 42KB)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Gold <ari@marketly.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-17T14:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal window + commit uplift question

Ari —

Thanks for the data and the heads-up. I reviewed the Q3 extract and chatted with Ops; spike patterns look bursty but predictable during campaign windows. We can do a staged uplift + short bridge approach that reduces your exposure to soft throttle while keeping unit price predictable.

Proposed structure (high level):
- Month 0–1 (bridge): +35% temporary buffer applied at no additional commit charge; persistent usage above buffer billed at current on-demand rates.
- Months 2–12 (committed): monthly committed tokens = current baseline * 2.5; commit floor guaranteed.
- Graceband: a 10% monthly variance pocket (non-cumulative) to absorb small jumps without triggering soft throttle.
- Rate: if you sign a 12-month amendment within 14 days, we’ll apply a 7% off list for the committed tiers and keep burst pricing capped at your present on-demand rate for the first 60 days.

I attached a redlined proposal (PDF) showing the monthly tiers and estimated monthly cost vs. on-demand. If this looks directionally right I’ll escalate to commercial and request a one-time graceband activation for the first month.

Next steps: can you confirm target start date for the uplift and whether procurement wants any PO language included?

–Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: marketly_commit_proposal_v2.pdf (PDF, 243KB)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:08:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Marketly renewal: variance buffer & graceband proposal

Karthik —

Looping you in. Sean’s proposed 7% concession + 10% monthly variance pocket is within our standard flexibility band, but Marketly is asking for a no-cost 35% bridge for the first 30 days which will require a one-off exception (revenue recognition delta + capacity guardrail).

Key considerations:
- Risk: if traffic stays at the elevated level beyond the 30-day bridge we need a clear throttling/fallback policy to avoid capacity exhaustion for other tenants.
- Billing ops: we’ll need to insert a clause that documents the bridge as a temporary provisioning credit and that usage above the bridge after month 1 reverts to committed or on-demand pricing as defined.

If you approve the exception, I’ll accept the redline and push the DocuSign envelope. If not, we can offer a smaller bridge (15%) and a shorter activation window.

Vanessa
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-27T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketly renewal: variance buffer & graceband proposal

Vanessa / Sean —

Approve the 30-day bridge at 25% (reduced from 35%) as a provisioning credit. Conditions:
1) Bridge applies once, effective start date must be inside the signed amendment window.
2) Graceband = 10% variance pocket, non-cumulative.
3) 7% discount on committed tiers if signed within 14 days.
4) If sustained elevated usage > bridge for 45+ days, automatic review and rebaseline conversation (ops + sales) with the customer; fallback policy: route non-critical inference to lower-cost model variants if capacity contention is detected.

Sean — please update the PDF to reflect 25% bridge and push DocuSign. Vanessa — copy procurement and ask for PO language (we will accept standard PO referencing the amendment id).

Karthik
Director, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
